title: A finite type quasi-coherent module on an affine scheme is generated by finitely many global sections
statement: Let $U$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Then there are finitely many global sections $h_1,\dots,h_k\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal G)$ which generate $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], i.e. the map $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus k}\to\mathcal G$, $(f_1,\dots,f_k)\mapsto\sum_jf_jh_j$, is surjective as a map of sheaves. In fact any finite family of elements generating the $\mathcal O_U(U)$-module $\Gamma(U,\mathcal G)$ (which is finitely generated) does.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PB (label lemma-finite-type-module) together with Schemes, Lemma 01IA (label schemes-lemma-quasi-coherent-affine: a quasi-coherent module on Spec R is the sheaf associated to its global sections); EGA I (1.3.13), cited in EGA II proof of 4.5.5

proof.text: Finite type is preserved on the over-site at the terminal open: reindex a finite local generating cover along Over.forget top and map its generators through the corresponding colimit-preserving pushforwards. All this transfer is proved by private helpers. Apply the affine finite-type criterion to top, obtaining Module.Finite for the global sections.

For any family of global sections whose top values span, let phi be freeHomEquiv.symm of that family. The top-values of the freeSection basis map to the chosen sections by sectionsMap_freeHomEquiv_symm_freeSection. Consequently the range of the top component, as a linear map, contains their span and is top. Apply epi_of_surjective_app on the singleton affine cover consisting of top to conclude Epi phi.

Module.Finite.exists_fin supplies a finite spanning family t : Fin k -> Gamma(G,top). Construct its compatible global sections by restricting each t_i to every open; the naturality proof is functoriality. Lift the index to ULift (Fin k), whose range of top-values is unchanged. Use the preceding epimorphism proof as the epi field of GeneratingSections. This also proves the assertion for every prescribed finite spanning family.

split_report.summary: Split into 4 steps following Properties 01PB, Schemes 01IA and 01HV: (1) reduce to U = Spec R and get M = Gamma(U,G) finitely generated from lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine (a), which carries 01PB; (2) G is isomorphic to M~ by the counit, which is an isomorphism (lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction (3), carrying 01IA); (3) stalks: G_x = M_p is generated over O_{U,x} by germs of global sections (Mathlib leaves lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-stalk-localization and lem-weil-pbc-spec-domain-stalks-function-field), so phi_x is surjective; (4) stalkwise surjective implies surjective (Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-locally-surjective-iff-stalks). This route needs no node for the exactness of M -> M~. Statement and stmt_deps kept. No new nodes. The Mathlib search was repeated (no match).
